info.author: Chris Lee-Messer
info.name: edflib
info.summary: python edflib is a python package ot allow access to European Data Format files (EDF for short). This is a standard for biological signals such as EEG, evoked potentials and EMG.  This module wraps Teunis van Beelen's edflib.
